other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must not be carrying a child
Applicant must be native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence of at least 5 years
Bridegroom must be a bachelor or a widower
Bride must be at least 18 years old and bridegroom at least 21 years old
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 provided as a National Savings Certificate.
